note: The ranking fence hits are crates/aft/src/commands/semantic_search/, crates/aft/src/search_b2/, crates/aft/src/search_index.rs (deleted), crates/aft/src/semantic_index.rs and crates/aft/src/lib.rs. The index store becomes the only source for aft_search's text and meaning lanes, and the old trigram index, semantic snapshot and views are deleted. Both lanes already read through data_layer::tools::search (TextIndex, MeaningIndex), and earlier slices replayed the concept, exact and real-query families through the index store with identical replies. Routing, scores and truncation are unchanged, so ranked rows must stay byte-identical to the committed reference. The one declared difference is the pattern lane's candidate count in nine rows (pattern_counts): the index store's trigram planner names a different set of files to read before matching, so candidate_files and files_examined change while files_matched, ranked paths and every rendered line stay the same. A reply reports the index's true candidate count, as Ufuk approved for the cutover.
